Join IMPRS-QST
Join our Doctoral Program
Whether you are just starting your PhD or are already well into your research, we invite you to join the vibrant IMPRS-QST and Munich Center for Quantum Science and Technology community.
From 2026 onward, the IMPRS-QST is part of the integrated MCQST Doctoral Program. This transition ensures a unified, high-standard experience for all doctoral researchers in Munich’s quantum landscape.
Why join our Doctoral Program?
By joining the MCQST Doctoral Program, you become part of an exceptional graduate training environment. You will gain access to:
Scientific Excellence: Specialized workshops, summer schools, and high-level networking events.
Professional Growth: Dedicated training and career development resources designed to help you thrive.
Structured Mentorship: Transparent supervision principles, including Thesis Advisory Boards and Progress Reports.
Funding & Resources: Access to additional support and international exchange opportunities.
Regardless of your funding source, all doctoral students within the program complete the same curriculum requirements and benefit from consistent support.
Registration and Next Steps
The MCQST Doctoral Program is now the primary framework for all quantum-focused doctoral researchers in Munich. How you engage with the program depends on your current status:
Current IMPRS-QST Member: No action needed. You are automatically integrated into the MCQST Doctoral Program and will continue your existing curriculum without interruption.
Current PhD Student (Joined <2026): Registration Open. If you are working in an MCQST-affiliated group but were not previously enrolled in IMPRS, you are now invited to register with the MCQST Doctoral Program to access full support and training.
New PhD Student (Joined 2026+): Direct Registration. All new doctoral researchers in MCQST-affiliated groups are encouraged to register for the MCQST Doctoral Program upon beginning their PhD.
Note on the transition: Previously, the IMPRS-QST served as the primary registration path for the Munich quantum doctoral students. From 2026 onward, the newly established MCQST Doctoral Program has taken over this role, providing a unified structure and expanded resources for all students, regardless of their starting date.
Contact and Support
To ensure a smooth transition, the IMPRS-QST and MCQST programs are managed by the same central office. All inquiries regarding curriculum options, formal requirements, or activities are handled by our joint coordination office.
If you have any questions, please feel free to reach out to us:
